title: Terms
lead: When you are paid and how long a quotation holds. Agents quote only terms written here.

fields.label: When do customers pay?
fields.hint: Such as: Half when the order is confirmed, half on delivery.

fields.label: How long does a quotation hold?
fields.hint: Such as: Thirty days from the day it is sent.

fields.label: Do you ask for a deposit?
fields.hint: Such as: Yes, before any work begins.

fields.label: Is there anything else customers should know?
fields.hint: Such as: Delivery, installation or late payment rules.
